note: Independent re-judgment at HEAD against RFC 7311 Section 4.1 ('Assuming that the BGP decision process invokes the tie-breaking procedures, the procedures in this section MUST be executed BEFORE any of the tie-breaking procedures described in [BGP], Section 9.1.2.2 are executed.'). Verified internal/component/bgp/plugins/rib/bestpath.go calls compareAIGP immediately after LOCAL_PREF and before AS_PATH (RFC 4271 Section 9.1.2.2(a)). TestAIGPSelectsStoredRoutesBeforeASPath positive pins equal LOCAL_PREF (100) where a route with longer AS_PATH (3 vs 1) and lower AIGP+IGPCost (20+10=30 vs 5+100=105) wins and publishes received metric 20; negative pins that higher LOCAL_PREF (101) without AIGP still precedes AIGP per Section 4, and at equal LOCAL_PREF a route with AIGP beats a shorter-AS_PATH route lacking AIGP (missing AIGP is not metric zero). Q1-Q4 pass.
